work_item.role: W1 public-evidence discovery and neutral admission

collection_state.note: Pass 42 was prepared raw-only while independent pass 40 PR #137 owned the generated registry surface. No registry views were modified and no PR was opened for this pass yet.

discovery_pass.method: Direction-blind admission preparation for five published Pilot 2 model-arm cells. W1 preserves the pre-registered arm definitions, pinned target revision, objective scoring components, one missing scheduled cell, and the mid-pilot reviewer-budget change without importing the publisher's causal or cost-efficiency conclusions.

source_known_dimensions: literal model ID claude-sonnet-5 is shared across the three arms
same primary runner timeout and max-turn budget
same deterministic visible-suite, tamper, and held-out success definition
explicit_unknown_or_nonidentical_dimensi: A1 and FULL intentionally add different harness mechanisms to A0
FULL reviewer turn budget changed from 4 to 20 during the pilot
exact Claude Code CLI version is unrecovered
exact service-side model revision is unrecovered
one stochastic run per task-arm cell

source_known_dimensions: literal model ID claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 is shared across the two arms
same deterministic visible-suite, tamper, and held-out success definition
explicit_unknown_or_nonidentical_dimensi: FULL intentionally adds harness mechanisms to A0
haiku FULL lacks scheduled task f2 and therefore has 7 rather than 8 graded runs
FULL reviewer turn budget changed from 4 to 20 during the pilot
exact Claude Code CLI version is unrecovered
exact service-side model revision is unrecovered
one stochastic run per observed task-arm cell

provenance_strength.w1_treatment: admit bounded model-arm outcome cells while preserving missingness and protocol deviation; no causal interpretation

protocol_deviations_and_failures.detail: The reviewer max-turn budget was increased from 4 to 20 during Pilot 2 after early reviewers exhausted the smaller budget. The source journals the change and leaves affected runs in place.
Task f2 was not run in the haiku FULL cell; the source reports 7/7 rather than imputing the missing eighth run.
Pilot 2 uses one run per scheduled task-model-arm cell; W1 records the aggregate but performs no stochastic reliability inference.

non_admission_dispositions.surface: publisher causal findings about whether harness layers add correctness
non_admission_dispositions.reason: W1 admits factual arm outcomes only and does not perform causal interpretation.
Costs and wall times are retained as source measurements, not as a recommendation or ranking.
That production surface has different provenance and conditions from the controlled Pilot 2 grid and is not required for this bounded batch.

validation.pending_reason: Independent pass 40 PR #137 currently owns the generated registry surface. Pass 42 has not yet run admission or regenerated registry views.
